default/32609.htm.text: Airship Controller: You see a floating piece of stone filled with a mysterious power. The green light is flashing, so there doesn't appear to be anything wrong with its function. Using this should allow you to board the Airship headed for the continent of Gracia.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
